book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Mahundo gha hilongohi bhetu Akaayahudi
Mbole, amoo bha Afalisayu na ahunda bha Malaghilo bhakihika kuhuma ku Yelusalemu, bhakinhikila Yesu na bhakinkonya.
“Kyabhuli ahundwa bhako bhangughakiluka mahundo gha ahunda bhetu bha makachu? Mana bhombe bhangukuha ng'obhe muhinoghwa handa hitohe hyetu, kukali ya kulyegha.”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Kyabhuli na mwenga munguyitikila ng'obhe Malaghilo gha Chapanga kwakya mahundo gha aghohi bhenu?
Kiyaha Chapanga kakilongela, ‘Ghubhahokamile Tate na mama ywako na ywakanligha tate ebhu mama ywake, kakomwe.’
Peni mwenga munguhunda kukita, handa mundu abhegha na kilibhi kya kuntangatila tate ywake ebhu mama ghwake, peni kalongela, ‘Aki kya Chapanga.’
Basi, munguhunda ghungunoghwa ng'obhe kunhokamila tate ebhu mama ywako kwa kuntangatila kumpegha kilibhi akyo. Ndo pamuliyuyuha Lilagho lya Chapanga kwa kutughila mahundo ghenu mabhene.
Mwenga maafyangu. Isaya kakilondola tela yakya mwenga pakalongela,

content.text: peni myoyo yabhe yibhegha kutali na nenga
Kutundamila kwa bhombe kungutangatila ng'obhe kilibhi,
bhanguhunda mahundo ghaayandihitwe na bhandu ghweka, na chepa mahundo gha nenga.’ ”

content: Milando yakuntenda mundu kayitikilwe kubhegha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga
Yesu kakilukema lula lumati lwa bhandu na kakiaghombela, “Nnyihwanile na mmanye.
Kiintenda mundu kakotoke kuyitikilwa kubhegha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga, chepa kila kiinnyingila mu nnomo ghwake, ngati ndo malagho ghanakummuka munnomo ghwake.”
Mbole ahundwa bhake bhakinng'endela na bhakinng'ombela, “Ghungumanya kukita akaafalisayo bhakekalala munu paayihwite mihalo yila yighuyikambukite?”
Peni ywombe kakiayanga, “Mmela ghwohele ghuupanditwe ng'obhe na Tate ywangu ywa kunane, ghwatupulwa.
Mubhaleke bhene, mana bhombe ndo hilongohi bha bhangabhona, bhaabhalongoha bhangabhona ayabhe. Na handa ywangalbhona katanlongoha ywangabhona nnyaki, bhoha abhili bhaachumbukila mulibhumba.”
Petili kakilongela, “Ghutufwambulile mana ya nhwano agho.”
Yesu kakiakonya, “Hata mwenga nkali kang'amula?
Bhuli, mungumanya ng'obhe kukita kyohele kiyingiliti mu nnomo kyaghenda mu lutumbo na mbole kyabhuhwa panje kupitila mumahi?
Peni kila kihuma mu nnomo kinguhuma mu mwoyo, na akyo ndo kinguntenda mundu kakotoke kuyitikilwa muulongolo ghwa Chapanga.
Kiyaha mu mwoyo ghanguhuma mahwacho gha uhakata, kukoma, utyahe, ungongola, bhwihi, uyimiho ghwa uhwangi na maligho.
Agho ndo ghanguntenda mundu kakotoke kuyitikilwa kubhegha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga, peni kulyegha kyangakuha mabhoko kunguntenda ng'obhe mundu kakotoke kuyitikilwa kubhegha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga.”
Kuhyubhalila kwa nndala ywa kuhuma ku Kanani
Yesu kakibhuka pala na kakighenda ku milima yiibheghite ugheghela na mbande hya Tilo na Sidoni.

Basi, nndala yumu ywa ku Kaanani ywakatamite ugheghela na mbande ahyo kakinhikila Yesu, kakiyobha kunu pakalongela, “Ghummonele luhungu Bambo, Mwana ywa Daudi, nhinja ywangu kakwelwa na lindilu na kangupamandika munu.”
Peni Yesu kakiyanga ng'obhe lilagho. Ndo ahundwa bhake bhaking'endela paannyupa munu, bhakenng'ombela, “Ghunng'ombele kaghende kiyaha kangugendelela kutututila kyobho.”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Naghilwa kwakya kualopoha mene bha Chapanga bhaahobhite, bhandu bha Isilaeli.”
Peni yula nndala kakihika, pakanchutama mayughwa mukulongolo ghwa Yesu, pakalongela, “Bambo ghundange.”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Yibhegha maha ng'obhe kuhitola hilyo hya bhana na kuataghila galu.”
Yula nndala kakinnyanga, “Kulyaghila Bambo, peni hata galu bhangulyegha mahighalo ghaahighalo gha abambo bhabhe.”
Ndo Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Nndala, kuhyubhalo kwa ghwenga kubhegha kukulu, yabheghe kwa ghwenga handa mughupala.” Naywo nhinja ywake kakilama kutandila lisaa lila lila.
Yesu kangualamiha bhandu atangalo
Yesu kakibhuka apo na kakighenda mumbweghambweha ya lihibha lya Galilaya, kakikwela kitumbi na kakitama.
Bhandu atangalo bhakinhikila, bhakiayegha atebhalo, ngwabhengwabhe, bhangbhonaa, bhangayihwa, na bhangi atangalo, bhakiatamika mu ulongolo ghwa maghulu ghake naywo Yesu kakialamiha.

Bhandu abho bhakikangacha muno paabhonite bhangalongela bhangulongela, atebhalo bhakilamihwa, ngwabhengwabhe bhangutyanga na bhangalola bhangubhona, bhakinkweha Chapanga ywakatundamilwa na Akaaisilaeli.
Yesu kanguapegha hilyo kangi bhandu elfu ncheche

Basi, Yesu kakiakema ahundwa bhake kakiaghombela, “Nungulubhonela luhungu lumati alu lwa bhandu, kiyaha abhegha na nenga kwa manjubha mandatu na abhegha ng'obhe na hilyo hyohele hiihighalite, na nenga mbala ng'obhe kubhalagha paabhegha na njala ngati akotoke kuhima mu njila.”
Ahundwa bhake bhakinkonya, “Apa tubhegha pangabhandu, twamokola kwoki hilyo hya kuakwila bhandu abha bhoha?”
Yesu kakiakonya, “Mmegha na mangati malingi?” Bhakinnyanga, “Mangate saba na hihomba hyamandina.”
Yesu kakilughombela lula lumati lwa bhandu atame pahi.
Kakighatola ghala mangate saba na hila hihomba hyamandina, kakinnumba Chapanga, kakihimetula na kakiapegha ahundwa bhake, nabho bhakiaghabhila bhandu.
Bhoha bhakilyegha na kuyukuta, mbole ahundwa bhake bhakikungana mahighalo na bhakimemekeha hikapu saba.
Bhala bhaalyeghiti bhakibhegha alumi elfu ncheche, kyanga kubhalangwa adala na bhana.
Ndo Yesu kakialagha bhandu, kakihubhuka mu bhwato na kakighenda ku mbande ya Magadani.
